origin: FilePackVer3.1 support: Python port of GARbro EncryptionV3_1 (rotated checksum and ArcKey, UTF-16LE name XOR, method-1/method-2 member ciphers, 0x400-byte key expansion) and the PackIndexReader pack_keyfile chain, with explicit modes, encrypt inverses and bounds added. HashVer1.4 lookup layout was cross-checked against msg-tool and validated on real archives read locally in read-only mode; the template writer preserves it verbatim after validation. No upstream lines of msg-tool were copied.

references.use: Algorithm port for the 3.1 reader and its inverse.

Layout cross-reference only: HashVer1.4 header fields (256 buckets, count, count*4 ordinal array, stored size, compression flag, 32 opaque bytes), u32 bucket depth, UTF-16LE names, u64 ordinal offsets, legacy 0x428 encryption of the lookup data.
